description: A standalone Go program that runs once to completion and prints its results.
author: jengakit

ui.hint: e.g. compute prime numbers up to 1000 and print each one
ui.description: Go CLI — runs to completion, prints to stdout. No HTTP server. One-shot container job (not a long-running service). Output captured from the container logs.

sample_prompts: Compute all prime numbers up to 10000 and print them
Generate a multiplication table from 1 to 12 and print it formatted
Calculate the first 50 Fibonacci numbers and display each one
